nda-1.description: All Confidential Information shall be expressly identified by the Disclosing Party.

nda-2.description: Confidential Information shall only include technical information.

nda-3.description: Confidential Information may include verbally conveyed information.

nda-4.description: Receiving Party shall not use any Confidential Information for any purpose other than the purposes stated in Agreement.

nda-5.description: Receiving Party may share some Confidential Information with some of Receiving Party's employees.

nda-7.description: Receiving Party may share some Confidential Information with some third-parties (including consultants, agents and professional advisors).

nda-8.description: Receiving Party shall notify Disclosing Party in case Receiving Party is required by law, regulation or judicial process to disclose any Confidential Information.

nda-10.description: Receiving Party shall not disclose the fact that Agreement was agreed or negotiated.

nda-11.description: Receiving Party shall not reverse engineer any objects which embody Disclosing Party's Confidential Information.

nda-12.description: Receiving Party may independently develop information similar to Confidential Information.

nda-13.description: Receiving Party may acquire information similar to Confidential Information from a third party.

nda-15.description: Agreement shall not grant Receiving Party any right to Confidential Information.

nda-16.description: Receiving Party shall destroy or return some Confidential Information upon the termination of Agreement.

nda-17.description: Receiving Party may create a copy of some Confidential Information in some circumstances.

nda-18.description: Receiving Party shall not solicit some of Disclosing Party's representatives.

nda-19.description: Some obligations of Agreement may survive termination of Agreement.

nda-20.description: Receiving Party may retain some Confidential Information even after the return or destruction of Confidential Information.
